announcement.title: 0.4.18-b1 updated — please redownload
announcement.message: 0.4.18-b1 has been updated in place with a privacy hotfix: avatar logging no longer runs for people who left the instance. Avatar lookups could previously continue for players who were no longer present — after they left while Scarlet and VRChat kept running, and for players from a previous instance or a closed VRChat session. Departed players still stay visible in the player table, but Scarlet no longer tracks them: every avatar path now checks presence before doing any work or recording any result, in-flight lookups are discarded when a player leaves, and join checks are skipped for anyone who left during log catch-up. This also removes a class of unnecessary avatar lookups and rate-limit pressure. If you downloaded 0.4.18-b1 before this update, please download it again — the version number is unchanged. 0.4.18-b1 also brings burst polling for near-instant moderation posts, avatar statuses without VRChat launch options, the avatar search provider manager, and the export progress/safety overhaul.
